task: Hardware doc audit: purge stale CPU/GPU identity from GameResearch and add an automated drift gate so it cannot recur.
context:
BRIEFING FOR GE-N1 — hardware-doc drift, and Alice status. Read ~/GameResearch/SESSION-STATE.md FIRST; it is the canonical carry-forward doc.

=== 1. THE CORE PROBLEM (already partially fixed by me — needs your audit) ===

GameResearch had NO single enforced source of truth for hardware identity, so stale specs survived in places nobody re-read. Root cause: values were hardcoded in generators and comments instead of derived from hardware-profile.md.

Canonical truth (verified against lscpu/lspci on this machine):
  CPU: Intel Core i7-13620H, Raptor Lake-H, 10 cores (6P+4E) / 16 threads
  GPU: Intel UHD Graphics, 64 EU, PCI ID 8086:a7a8, driver Intel iHD 26.1.2 / Mesa 26.0.8
  RAM: 16 GB DDR5, SINGLE-CHANNEL SODIMM @ 5200 MT/s, 2nd slot empty
  Display: 1920x1080 @ 60 Hz, desktop scale MUST be 100%

Two earlier docs claimed i7-13700H 14C/20T and "Iris Xe 96EU". BOTH WRONG on both counts. The i7-13620H has NO Iris Xe SKU at all. 64 execution units is the whole die; a second RAM stick is bandwidth only and can never add EUs. Intel's "single-channel drops EU count" rule is Tiger Lake only and does not apply here.

=== 2. WHAT I ALREADY FIXED (verify, don't redo) ===

a) compact_prep.py — THE WORST OFFENDER. It hardcoded the hardware line in an f-string, so `make compact-prep` actively WROTE STALE SPECS TO DISK on every run. It also overwrote compaction/SUMMARY.md wholesale (destroying curated content), hardcoded 3 of 14 install scripts, 4 of 6 genre maps, and carried an obsolete next-priority list.
   Rewritten as a POINTER: hardware parsed from hardware-profile.md at runtime, all lists enumerated from disk, SESSION-STATE.md declared canonical with an explicit "SESSION-STATE wins on disagreement" rule, output stamped generated/do-not-hand-edit.
   Verify: `cd ~/GameResearch && make compact-prep && sed -n '15,17p' compaction/SUMMARY.md`

b) install-recipes/{freedroidrpg,bar-fix,lurking-i}.sh — each carried a "Our Machine" comparison table with i7-13700H and Iris Xe 96EU. Corrected to i7-13620H 10C/16T and Intel UHD Graphics 64EU. All 14 recipes pass `bash -n`.
   Verify: `cd ~/GameResearch/install-recipes && grep -n "13700H\|Iris Xe 96EU" *.sh` (expect no output)

=== 3. YOUR JOB — add a drift gate, do not just re-grep once ===

A grep today proves nothing about tomorrow. Please add a make target (suggested: `make hardware-drift`) that FAILS LOUDLY when any of these appear outside the one legitimately-correct line in hardware-profile.md:
  - 13700H, 14C/20T, 20 threads
  - Iris Xe 96EU / G7 96EUs / "Iris Xe" as our GPU
  - dual-channel RAM described as present
  - a hardware line hardcoded in any .py generator
Suggested implementation: scan *.md, *.sh, *.py under ~/GameResearch, allowlist hardware-profile.md, exclude vendor/ and benchmarks/, print file:line for every hit, exit non-zero on any. Wire it into a `make docs-check` or as a pre-commit hook. Do NOT edit vendor/vnr-work/ — nested repo, separate domain.

=== 4. ALICE 2011 — status, so you don't duplicate me ===

Game root: /home/xnai/Games/Alice1_2011_vanilla/Alice1/bin
alice.exe is AlicePatch-patched (sha256 c0a7f8493933449e2feb2fa1edbd6e3b03be30b16df9f8f6057239a05ef74dc4). VorpalFix 4.0.1 loads as vfgamex86.dll beside it; there is NO winmm.dll and the Lutris env override is empty. Runner is really wine-11.0 (CachyOS) despite the UI saying "Proton 7.0". esync/fsync disabled, DXVK off.

Two claims I disproved this session, both mine:
  - A parallel session "fixed the saves" — it never touched Alice. 16 .sav files verified byte-identical to my 2026-09-27 backup, zero deletions.
  - VorpalFix 4.0.1's winmm.dll override loads but applies NO graphics fixes on this build (it reads winmm from C:\Windows\system32). AlicePatch + vfgamex86.dll is the working path, confirmed by loader trace.

Verified just now by me:
  - LAUNCH IS FINE. 30s run, no crash, and xwininfo confirms window "American McGee's Alice" at 1920x1080+0+0. Also an "Alice Console" window — that is WindowConsoleMode=0, which I enabled for diagnosis and have NOT yet reverted. Reverting it is a one-line change and is yours if you want it.
  - FULLSCREEN ROOT CAUSE: the game REWRITES config.cfg on exit and always persists r_fullscreen 0. Hand-editing the config therefore cannot work — I set r_fullscreen 1 and the game clobbered it. Durable fix applied: ForceBorderlessFullscreen=1 + AutoResolution=1 in VorpalFix.ini (runtime hooks, cannot be clobbered) with FixFullscreenSetting=1. Backup made. Result: r_fullscreen is now absent from config.cfg entirely, which is the correct FixFullscreenSetting=1 behaviour.
  - GOTCHA worth recording, already in the agent file as Known Trap #9: FixFullscreenSetting is INVERTED from its own comment. 1 = skip base default so YOUR config wins; 0 = base default (r_fullscreen 0) applies = forced windowed. The base/default_pc.cfg ships r_fullscreen 0. I set 0 by misreading it and it cost a debug cycle.

=== 5. SAVES — data is sound, LOAD behaviour is the open question ===

16 .sav in <prefix>/drive_c/users/steamuser/Documents/My Games/American McGee's Alice/save/ (NOT base/config.cfg — different trap).
I verified integrity without playing: all 16 have unique md5s, distinct sizes, and distinct body hashes from offset 4KB onward (gvillage0000/0005/0010/quicksave/pandemonium0000/fortress10000 all differ) — so they contain genuinely different game states, not copies. .ssv headers carry correct level names: 12x gvillage, 3x pandemonium, 1x fortress1.
Operator recalls every save loading to the very beginning of level 1. UNVERIFIED — needs a human to load one and report. Note gvillage IS level 1, so "start of gvillage" may be correct for the gvillage saves. The thing to distinguish: does pandemonium0002 load into pandemonium, or back at the village start? If pandemonium saves also load at the village start, that is a real bug and the next suspect is OptimizeSaveSpeed's write buffering — disable it and retest, it only affects speed, not correctness. Second suspect: the game's own save/load path under this Wine build, in which case test with a fresh save made right now and loaded immediately.

Do not delete or regenerate any .sav. A verified 52-file duplicate is at ~/GameResearch/benchmarks/alice-save-backup-20260927-040614/.

=== 6. COLLABORATION ===

Multiple GE sessions run in parallel across Node 0/1. Protocol now in SESSION-STATE.md: that file is the only shared truth; if it does not mention a game, no session has done work on it regardless of claims; verify cross-session claims against disk before building on them; write to it when a lane finishes or blocks. My last commit is 6ffafaf. Please append your findings there rather than in a private scratch file.
